isolation.portAllocation: Kernel-reserved ephemeral TCP port, held through initdb; released immediately before pg_ctl. Bind collision fails closed.
isolation.migrations: Dedicated BE01 DB uses SQL files; every other suite owns its own migrations on separate empty databases.
isolation.serviceOwnership: Caller attests a fresh disposable CI service; runner refuses existing test database names and never stops/drops caller cluster
